author: Brandjuh
name: CuffPurge
short: Empty a channel of every message, with a confirmation and a stop button.
description: Deletes every message in a channel — the blunt operation Red's Cleanup cog deliberately has no command for. Asks for confirmation first, naming the channel and the number of pinned messages at stake; pinned messages are kept unless explicitly included. A running purge can be stopped from a button and reports how far it got. Messages newer than 14 days go via bulk delete; older ones are deleted individually, which is slow, so progress is reported live. Every run is attributed to whoever started it in the audit log.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no data. It deletes messages on request and records who requested the deletion in Discord's own audit log; message content is never read into storage or sent anywhere.
install_msg: Thanks for installing CuffPurge. `[p]purge all` empties the channel you run it in, `[p]purge all #channel` another one. You are asked to confirm first, and pinned messages are kept unless you pass `yes` as the last argument.
